name: Mirecrown Linnorm - Young
description: Young Mirecrown is a chaotic, instinct-driven worldborn linnorm clever, wingless, non-humanoid linnorm with mud-caked scales, reed-crowned sensory spines, and a broad paddle tail. It seeks to restore blocked waterways and defend its nesting grounds. At this age it is an emerging but formidable predator.

attacks.name: Ambush Bite
attacks.description: The linnorm strikes one target within Very Close range with its primary natural weapons.

abilities.name: Relentless (2)
abilities.description: The linnorm can be spotlighted up to 2 times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

abilities.name: Mud Camouflage
abilities.description: Before the linnorm first attacks or after it becomes Hidden in a wetland, a creature must succeed on an Instinct Roll to locate it.

abilities.name: Choking Spray
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to exhale a cone reaching Close range. All enemies in the cone make an Agility Reaction Roll against Difficulty 15. On a failure, take 2d8+4 physical damage and the target marks 1 Stress from bile and rotting peat. On a success, take half damage without the additional effect.

abilities.name: Roused Fury
abilities.description: Once per scene, immediately after the linnorm marks half its total HP (round up), clear 1 Stress and move up to Close range. This movement does not grant an attack.
